changelog: Large-file crash fixed: songs are streamed straight into the AI engine instead of being decoded into memory, so long recordings no longer exhaust RAM

New AI voice engine (AudioWorklet): adaptive spectral separation that learns each track while it plays — centre-channel coherence, pitch/harmonic tracking, syllabic modulation and live voice/music profiles
Music mode removed completely: no mode selector, no stem mixer, no music fader and no karaoke/mix exports — every song plays as pure voice, automatically
Live AI panel: voice activity, music-cut dB, tracked pitch, engine state and processing latency
Safer WAV export: the purified voice is recorded while the song plays and written in chunks (native finishWav header patch), so a two-hour file is as safe as a three-minute one
Phone-library streaming with HTTP range support in the Android host, so seeking works on huge files without copying them into JavaScript memory
Offline & private: 100% on-device processing; songs never leave your phone
